scope.analysis_kind: repository-bound semantic/runtime fault model plus executable corrective slice

functioning_contract: reachable: launch -> pair -> setup -> admission -> ACTIVE is bounded, observable and recoverable
causally_closed: every user mutation has one typed validated writer path and either changes one versioned runtime state or fails explicitly
effect_observable: every behavior-changing configuration exposes the revision actually consumed by the relevant cycle
surface_complete_minimal: all user-governable runtime abstractions are declared by one manifest and undeclared controls are absent
surface_equivalent: webapp and floating consume the same semantic contract and differ only by layout/progressive disclosure
authority_safe: presentation and configuration never widen permission, approval, grant, lease or execution authority
recoverable: reload, restart, stale assets, transport loss and replaceable-component changes converge or block explicitly
oracle_bound: each material Definition-of-Done claim has an executable oracle crossing the same physical/runtime boundary

as_is.surface_topology: one local PWA/runtime surface; floating is currently a compact presentation profile, not a second native host
closed_paths: single-writer shell with exact frame ACK
generation-only experiment config with CAS revision
session identity / synthetic neuromodel / audit projections
material_gaps: runtime views are assembled by independent endpoints/pollers rather than one atomic versioned surface snapshot
saved experiment config has no user-facing same-cycle consumed-revision receipt
there is no machine-readable all-and-only runtime surface manifest
memory influence is not exposed through a complete read/forget governance surface
temporal tasks/wakes are mainly projected as runtime status rather than a complete governed user surface
S15 work graph and deterministic command plan are not consumed by canonical TURN routing
S15 hybrid membrane/commercial assist are not integrated into canonical TURN and have no activation receipt
floating has no separate native host capability and therefore must not be presented as OS always-on-top functionality
effective provider destination/redirect pinning remains required before commercial activation
repository merge governance is described more strongly than GitHub branch protection currently enforces

fault_space_monte_carlo.interpretation: coverage of the declared modeled fault vocabulary; not an empirical production failure probability

markov_stress_model.transition_rule: handled injected faults recover/self-loop; unhandled declared faults transition to DEGRADED; no-fault advances
markov_stress_model.interpretation: synthetic comparative stress model; probabilities are conditional on the declared model and are not measured reliability

architecture_saturation.bound: minimality is only claimed inside the explicitly declared 20-intervention design vocabulary

web_runtime_parameterization.target_rule: prefer event/revision-triggered refresh; one versioned surface snapshot replaces independent semantic pollers
